Application Data.NAME: ABC Shipping Solutions
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: ABC Shipping Solutions provides comprehensive mailing and shipping services, including parcel handling, package tracking, and customer notifications. Our operations adhere strictly to all postal and shipping regulations, and we maintain a secure facility with surveillance cameras and controlled access. Additionally, we offer ancillary services such as mailbox rentals and document copying, all managed with robust operational procedures to ensure high levels of security and customer service.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 03/15/2023, water damage occurred due to a burst pipe in the storage area, resulting in repairs costing $1,500. The issue has been resolved, and necessary preventative measures have been implemented. On 07/22/2023, a minor theft incident involved the loss of office supplies valued at $1,000. The theft was reported to local authorities, and security improvements were made. Both incidents have been closed and do not affect current operations.
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Surveillance cameras and controlled access security systems in place, along with on-site security personnel during operating hours.
